text: As armies sweep through his village on Lake Biwa, the potter Genjūrō [sends his wife Miyagi and their small son back to shore|wrong|abandonment and rejection] and sails on to sell his wares, while his brother-in-law Tōbei chases a dream of samurai armour. A noblewoman, Lady Wakasa, orders pottery for her mansion and [draws Genjūrō into marriage|wants|to be loved and belong]. Only a priest who [paints sacred symbols on his body|rules|faith and charms protect] can loosen her hold, and the road home leads to [a house where someone is still waiting|ending|loved ones reunited].
